verdict.rationale: SumUp's developer refund guide documents full and partial refunds of a previously processed payment, which covers the API surface of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows refunds issued from the point of sale or the merchant dashboard, or confirms the money returns to the original card. Missing for 10: refund capability at the point of sale, refund capability in the dashboard, explicit confirmation of refund to the original card, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API

citations.quote: When you complete these steps, the payment you have previously processed through SumUp will be refunded either partially or in full.
In this guide, you will learn how to refund a transaction... Option A: Make a full refund... Option B: Make a partial refund
